# it was before 24.11.2026 (the commit of the official tree in the base of every hash,
# no files of the official tree in the hash of a port, a dependency only to run by its
# whole hash), kept as they are (tools/build.sh, hash_same): a line each,
#   <level> <origin> <the az_hash of its package> <the az_hash of its port then>
# A line counts while the az_hash of its port is the one it says: once the port

# more. Without these lines a new pin would build those packages again (their old
# hash takes the commit of the official tree). From the plan run 45421497510 of
